about: Skateboards: rolling on rough and smooth ground, pushing, the ollie's pop, landing, grinding a rail and the board clattering away.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest. v4: flip, catch, revert and the held grind and slide for the trick overhaul.

prompts.text: A skateboard rolls along rough asphalt: a steady gritty rumbling of hard urethane wheels, constant. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard rolls along smooth concrete: a steady clean hum of the wheels with a soft click over each joint, constant. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboarder pushes off: a foot scuffs the ground and the board rolls on, six separate pushes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A skateboarder does an ollie: the sharp crack of the tail popping on the ground and the wheels landing with a clack, five separate ollies with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard lands hard on concrete after a jump: a loud wooden clack and the wheels' slap, five separate landings with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard grinds along a metal rail: a harsh scraping metallic screech, three separate grinds with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard flies away from its rider and clatters across concrete, tumbling and banging, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

flip.want: the deck flicked into a spin

prompts.text: A skateboarder kicks a skateboard into a flip: a quick wooden flick and the whirr of the deck spinning in the air, five separate flips with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A skateboarder's shoes slap down onto the grip tape of a spinning board: a sharp double clap of rubber soles on wood, five separate catches with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A skateboard's wheels slide sideways and scrape round on smooth concrete as it turns half a circle: a short rubbery hiss, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard's metal trucks grind steadily along a long concrete ledge: a constant rough metallic scraping and rumble, without pause. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A skateboard slides sideways along a ledge on the wood of its deck: a constant dry wooden hiss and scrape, without pause. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
